Track 1 follow-up to selfrep-terminal and selfrep-satmarket: dynamic programming with a terminal reward s per machine in a saturating market. Linear case matches the closed form; at market capacity ≤1000 even s = 0.25 a/k makes copying to the end optimal. Stylised, all inputs assumed. 4 tests, `python site/build.py` prints ok.

comments.body:
Closing as a duplicate of #457 (`selfrep-terminalmarket`, merged at 18:10 UTC), which built the same project in parallel. Useful lead for a follow-up: this branch's DP linearly extrapolates the value past the fleet-grid top (instead of holding it flat). With that change the DP policy was never beaten by bang-bang and the table-vs-policy gap fell from about -10% to about +5% (see `research/selfrep-termsat/src/selfrep_termsat/model.py` and `experiments/results.txt` on this branch). That addresses the "DP not reliable where the final fleet is large" limitation in `selfrep-terminalmarket`.
